title: Debrief (machine-checkable extract)
description: The units/<UID>/debrief.json artifact (JSON-only; no debrief.md). Gates the evidence-table plumbing (claim types drawn from references/evidence-standards.md), the budget report, and the ANSWERED 4-key socratic block (result of the pre-output self-interrogation). The executor reasons free-form in its reply, then writes this JSON; the narrative lands in the `result`/`handoff_notes` string fields.

socratic.description: CANONICAL 4-key socratic block. Result of the free-form FORK.COUNTER.ADMIT.PIVOT.RESIDUAL self-interrogation, never the dialogue itself. counter must record an OUTCOME (validator rejects blank/'n/a'; mechanical-unit sentinel = 'unit is mechanical; no material premise to break'). confidence starts high|medium|low (same vocabulary as the top-level `confidence` enum; the socratic value may add a trailing '— <uncertainty>').

footprint.description: Actual token usage report. within_budget is defined RELATIVE TO THIS UNIT: within_budget := (tokens_consumed <= this unit's brief.budget_tokens), NOT the global 32K (F2). tokens_consumed has NO maximum (IMP-04/PR-6): a REAL overrun must be recordable truthfully rather than forced to lie under the old maximum:32000 cap. The plan-side 32K ceiling lives on brief.budget_tokens / graph.est_footprint_tokens (untouched — you still cannot PLAN >32K). validate_run.py I5 FAILs a tokens_consumed > brief.budget_tokens paired with within_budget:true. The if/then below is a coarser schema-only backstop (a schema cannot read the per-unit brief.budget_tokens): any report of tokens_consumed>32000 MUST ALSO self-identify as over-budget (within_budget:false), so the re-atomization discipline (SKILL.md Scope note) consumes an honest signal.

prior_feedback.description: Retries only (iteration>1): verbatim echo of iteration n-1's verify.feedback (actionable_changes + do_not_touch) plus >=1 concrete change made in response (AO-6). Home for what was formerly the debrief.md 'Prior feedback' section under JSON-only artifacts. On a retry the presence + non-empty changes_made + do_not_touch echo are now SCHEMA-REQUIRED (see the allOf clause below — IMP-05/PR-6); the echo's CONTENT stays executor-attested.

case_set_discharge.description: OPTIONAL. The per-entry discharge record for the brief's case_set[] (case_set contract SPEC.md section 3). One row per frozen brief entry (origin 'orchestrator'), plus any entry the executor ADDed (origin 'executor') - this array is the ONLY home for an added entry (D13b); there is no addendum file and no brief amendment. Per row it records whether every required observation was made and every forbidden observation was demonstrated absent (outcome), and the non-vacuity result where one applies (non_vacuity, discharged-only). Totality over the frozen brief and the tier floor are adjudicated OFFLINE by verify.case_set_audit.discharge_check, not by this schema (a schema cannot read the sibling brief).

non_vacuity.description: SPEC section 3.2: one member per observation. On a discharged row the multiset of observation_ref values MUST equal, byte for byte, the entry's required_observations UNION forbidden_observations - a CROSS-ARTIFACT check for an orchestrator row (the lists live only in the brief), so it is adjudicated offline, not here.

allOf.$comment: reason REQUIRED exactly when counterfactual_result is 'not-run'; MUST be absent when 'red'. The `pattern: \S` bar above is load-bearing: a bare minLength:1 let a single space satisfy it, which is what made 'not-run' cost one keystroke.

SPEC section 3.1: the id is a CONDITIONAL on origin, in the if/then idiom - an orchestrator row cites the frozen brief id verbatim (^C[0-9]+$), an executor ADD carries its own (^CX[0-9]+$). Prefix/origin disagreement is a FAIL.

SPEC section 3.1: for an orchestrator entry the section-2.1 fields live in the frozen brief; re-stating them here creates a second copy that can be quietly narrowed - that is how 'never shrink' is violated without leaving a trace. So they MUST be absent on an orchestrator row and REQUIRED on an executor ADD (each under its own section-2.1 condition; the none-reason companions stay conditional below).

SPEC section 3.2: non_vacuity is REQUIRED when outcome is 'discharged' and MUST be absent otherwise (it is discharged-only, which is why vacuity_finding is the only field carrying the vacuity result).
SPEC section 3.1: infeasible_reason REQUIRED when outcome is 'infeasible'; MUST be absent otherwise. Silence here is the 'dropped it silently' failure DoD 2 forbids.

SPEC section 3.1: vacuity_finding REQUIRED exactly when outcome is 'vacuous'; MUST be absent otherwise. Decidable from wire values alone - one key, one value, no inference about which of several causes applied.

SPEC section 3.1: asserted_reason REQUIRED when evidence_tier is 'asserted'; MUST be absent otherwise. Symmetric with infeasible_reason - the iteration-1 asymmetry was the cheapest route to a fully green, fully evidence-free case set.
SPEC section 2.1: exactly one of requirement_ref / requirement_ref_none_reason on an entry that carries either - never both.
SPEC section 2.1 (I21 explicit-none): an executor ADD with an empty forbidden_observations owes the none-reason, whose content test names the clauses searched for in the requirement_ref text.
SPEC section 2.1: production_path false must be a DECISION, not a default - it owes the none-reason naming why the requirement has no consumer surface.

allOf.description: Retry echo mandatory (IMP-05/PR-6). A retry (iteration>=2) MUST carry the prior_feedback echo, and that echo MUST record >=1 concrete change (changes_made non-empty, AO-6) plus the do_not_touch echo field (present; may be [] for an honest 'nothing passed yet', AO-2). Closes the 'evasion by omission' half of Limitation F (I14/I15 were presence-gated: a retry omitting the whole block skipped both checks). A schema-invalid retry debrief is dropped before the I14/I15 comparison, so this is now the load-bearing presence gate; I14/I15 remain as the semantic backstop over schema-valid retries. First attempts (iteration:1) are untouched.
